purpose: Single machine-readable lifecycle vocabulary for canonical THC Encyclopedia lessons. Publication, scientific review, visual review, assessment review, accessibility review, and live verification are independent states.
invariants: canonical public lesson routes use permanent THC-ENC IDs rather than mutable title slugs
human-readable status text must not claim publication is unauthorized when publicationAuthorized=true
legacy route metadata may be detected during migration but must never override the generated canonical public route
